question: Given that 132⁰.¹⁴ = x, 132⁰.²⁶= y and xz = y² , then the value of z is close to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equating powers directly since the bases are identical in xz = y² :

⇒ 0.14 × z = 0.26 × 2

⇒ 0.14z = 0.52

⇒ z = 52 ÷ 14 ≈ 3.71

**∴ The correct answer is 3.71.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = 132⁰.¹⁴

y = 132⁰.²⁶

xz = y²

**Formula Used:**

(am)ⁿ = amⁿ

If am = aⁿ, then m = n (where a > 0 and a ≠ 1)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Substitute the given values of x and y in the equation xz = y² :

⇒ (132⁰.¹⁴)z = (132⁰.²⁶)²

⇒ Applying the power of a power rule to multiply the exponents:

⇒ 132⁰.¹⁴z = 132⁽⁰.²⁶ × ²⁾

⇒ 132⁰.¹⁴z = 132⁰.⁵²

⇒ Comparing the exponents since the bases are identical:

⇒ 0.14z = 0.52

⇒ z = 0.52 ÷ 0.14

⇒ z = 52 ÷ 14

⇒ z = 26 ÷ 7

⇒ z ≈ 3.714

**∴ The correct answer is 3.71.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule of Exponents

When multiplying expressions with identical bases, you must add the powers: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ

Quotient Rule of Exponents

When dividing expressions with identical bases, you must subtract the powers: am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

Power of a Power Rule

When raising an exponential expression to another power, simply multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = am×ⁿ

Equating Exponents

If two exponential terms with the exact same base are mathematically equal, their exponents will be equal: If ax = ay, then x = y.
